title: What If You Stepped Outside in the Coldest Town on Earth?

scenes.text: What if you stepped outside in the coldest town on Earth? Your eyelashes freeze first.
Oymyakon in Siberia averages minus 50 Celsius in January. Its record is minus 67.7, set in 1933.
At minus 59 Celsius, bare skin can get frostbite in under five minutes.
Pen ink freezes, batteries die, and glasses can freeze onto your face.
Locals leave car engines running all day, because a car that's shut off might never restart.
Winter brings about 21 hours of darkness a day, and digging one grave takes days of bonfires to thaw the ground.
